lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 distinct vertical white lines are visible. Spacing is significantly wider on the anterior torso and becomes progressively narrower and more irregular as lines move toward the posterior.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Visible Y-shaped bifurcations occur at the ventral (lower) segments of the 5th and 7th lines when counting from the anterior (shoulder).
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The 9th, 10th, and 11th lines are discontinuous, appearing as a series of vertically aligned dots and dashes that fail to reach the dorsal or ventral margins.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of approximately 5-6 high-contrast white spots is located on the mid-to-lower haunch and the upper portion of the hind limb.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two prominent spots on the posterior haunch align horizontally, forming a short semi-linear geometric pattern.

other_distinctive_markers: White chevron marking between the eyes; white circular spots on the cheek and lower mandible; distinct white transverse bands on the upper interior and exterior of the forelimbs and hindlimbs.
